name: Administrative TOTP Reset Success
summary: An authorized, recently step-up-authenticated operator invalidates the target user's TOTP enrollment and recovery-code material without authenticating the target user.

guards.expression: actor is authorized to reset target-user MFA and has fresh step-up proof

sourceReferences.note: ResetMfaAsync currently supplies the target state-clearing primitive through the same secret-removal/state-cleanup implementation as DisableMfaAsync.
The existing /api/auth/mfareset endpoint is confirmed-current-user only and therefore does not yet satisfy this privileged target-user transition.
Administrative reset only removes the unusable MFA enrollment. The target user must subsequently authenticate through a normal permitted sign-in path.
